narr: During the overnight hours on July 3rd, a cluster of slow moving and strong storms pushed through west-central Wisconsin. Strong to severe wind gusts resulted in some sporadic instances of tree damage in Jackson County. Additionally, the persistent heavy rain resulted in flash flooding between Alma Center and Black River Falls along County Road F.
ev: County Dispatch reported water flowing over County Road F between Black River Falls and Alma Center with the roadway washed out in spots.
lsr: Water flowing over County Road F between Black River Falls and Alma Center. Potential washout of roadway.
